name: Sunfrill Imitator — "you may have it become a copy of another target Dinosaur you control": "it" is the card, and only your other Dinosaurs are offered
notes: "Whenever this creature attacks, you may have it become a copy of another target Dinosaur you control, except its name is Sunfrill Imitator and it has this ability." Found by the self-copy audit unit (2026-11-18). Two faults: the fired text turned "it" into a guessed "target creature" (_addAbilityPseudo), so the card was offered as its own copy; and the copy restriction is built from card-type words only, so "Dinosaur" was dropped and every creature, artifact, enchantment and land was offered. With a trigger about the card itself, "it become(s) a copy of" now reads "this creature …", and params.targetFilter (buildAppliesToFromText of the copied object's words) is asked as well when they hold more than type words.
